counties.notes: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government (LFUCG) publishes Fayette County's parcels on its own ArcGIS Online organization: the Parcel FeatureServer (item e4a525d8772741468205e82fc173db22, credited to LFUCG GIS, LFUCG Addressing, LFUCG Planning and the Fayette County Property Valuation Administrator) holds 114,433 parcels inside the county (extent about 84.66 to 84.28 W, 37.84 to 38.21 N). It publishes no owner name and no owner mailing address. PVANUM is the PVA parcel number, 8 characters on 114,280 rows and blank on 14; ADDRESS is the full site address (blank on 17), with its parts in NUM1, NUM2, DIR, NAME and TYPE; UNIT is filled on 6,795 rows; CLASS is a one-letter property class (R on 101,590 rows, C on 6,156, blank on 301); PVA_ACRE is the PVA acreage. The server answers any origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), pages results and returns up to 2,000 rows per request. The item's licence field is LFUCG's Terms of Use: the data is provided "as is" and used at the user's sole risk (section V.B), and section VI.B reads: "To the fullest extent permitted by law, You shall indemnify and save harmless the LFUCG, from any claim, loss, damage, injury or liability of any kind, nature and description (including, without limitation, incidental and consequential damages, court costs, attorney’s fees and costs of investigation), that arise directly or indirectly, in whole or in part, from Your use of the Data, including without limitation Your use of the Data in a Derivative Work. In addition to Your obligation to indemnify the LFUCG, You specifically acknowledge and agree that You have an immediate and independent obligation to defend the LFUCG from any claim which actually or potentially falls within this indemnification provision, even if the allegations are or may be groundless, false or fraudulent, which obligation arises at the time such claim is tendered to You by LFUCG and continues at all times thereafter." LFUCG's open data hub is data-lfucg.hub.arcgis.com. Until 2026-10-17 this record pointed at services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd Tax_Parcels, which belongs to the Fairbanks North Star Borough, Alaska: 63,924 parcels around 64.24 to 65.44 N, 143.85 to 148.73 W.

basis.note: LFUCG's public parcel layer for Fayette County carries the PVA parcel number, site address, unit, property class and acreage only; it has no owner-name column.

counties.notes: Boone County, Kentucky (Florence, Burlington, Union; FIPS 21015). The county's tax parcel layer on its own ArcGIS Online organisation (Boone County Planning Commission, GIS Services Division), layer 0 'Tax Parcels': 55,275 parcels, maxRecordCount 2,000, pagination on, native State Plane feet (outSR=4326 works), CORS open (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). The parcel id is PIDN (format 999.99-99-999.99). The owner is PRCLOWNR1 (PRCLOWNR2 is the second owner; 55,229 of the rows carry one), the situs is SITEADD1 with CITYNAME and SITEZIP, and the owner mailing address is MAILADD1/MAILADD2 plus MAILPOST, MAILSTATE and MAILZIP. ASSESSVALU is a single assessed value with no land/improvement split, GMDACRE is the GIS acreage, and up to three sales ride on SALEDATE1-3/SALEPRICE1-3 (SALEDATE is a mm/dd/yyyy string). 14 rows carry the owner CONFIDENTIAL and most of those also carry a CONFIDENTIAL mailing address; the service description says nothing about why. The planning commission publishes this layer; the Boone County PVA is a separate office. The layer was last edited 2026-10-08. Verified 2026-10-09 by a count, field list, owner and mailing fill counts and a count of the sample query's predicate (488 rows).

counties.notes: Jefferson County, Kentucky (Louisville; FIPS 21111; the county is consolidated with Louisville Metro). 'Jefferson County KY Parcels', layer 1 of LojicSolutions/OpenDataPVA on the Louisville/Jefferson County Information Consortium (LOJIC) server: 293,248 parcel polygons, maxRecordCount 2,000, pagination on, State Plane feet (outSR=4326 works), CORS reflects the request Origin. The layer carries only PARCELID (293,217 rows), LRSN, PARCEL_TYPE and the polygon; its PIN column is empty on every row, and there is no owner, situs, mailing, value or sale column. Owner names are not published on this layer, so owner_name is recorded as not published. WHY THIS LAYER AND NOT METRO'S: Louisville Metro's New_AllParcels FeatureServer (services1.arcgis.com/79kfd2K6fskCAkyg, 289,963 rows) adds an Address and a property class, but its last edit is 2017-01-10 and its backing item (titled 'Commercial Parcels') was last modified in 2017, so it is a nine-year-old snapshot; LOJIC's layer is the consortium's own open-data parcel layer. The LojicData folder on the same server needs a token. No terms are published on the service. Verified 2026-10-09 by a count, field list and fill counts.

counties.notes: No public REST parcel layer was found for Casey County, Kentucky (county seat Liberty; FIPS 21045) as of 2026-10-12. The Casey County PVA (Property Valuation Administrator) publishes its parcel search and map through qPublic (qpublic.net/ky/casey), which has no REST interface. Searches of ArcGIS Online (feature and map services, for 'Casey County parcels', 'Casey_Parcels' and 'Casey PVA') and of the ArcGIS Hub API found no Kentucky Casey parcel item, while the same search shape finds Simpson County's 'Public Access Parcels', which is registered in this file, so the absence is meaningful. The Kentucky state server (kygisserver.ky.gov, WGS84WM_Services) carries one PVA parcel service, Webster County's, which is registered in this file, and nothing for Casey; the state viewer path kygeonet.ky.gov/pva/casey returns HTTP 404 where kygeonet.ky.gov/pva/webster returns 200. Kentucky has no statewide parcel layer yet: the Geographic Information Advisory Council minutes of 2026-04-15 report that 108 of 120 counties have supplied parcel data and 2.2 million parcels are appended in a dashboard that is still a work in progress, and that owner information will be stripped out, with only counties that opt in continuing to share ownership, so when a state layer publishes Casey may carry geometry without owners. This record answers a county request filed through the site's free tools. Parcel and owner records are available through the PVA's qPublic site, or by asking the Casey County PVA office for a shapefile or a hosted layer: (606) 787-7621. Re-check when the state layer publishes.

coverage.summary: Casey County's property valuation office publishes parcels only through qPublic, which has no query service, and Kentucky has no statewide parcel layer yet, so we don't index it. Search the PVA's qPublic site, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.
